skills.title: Lecture Planning
skills.summary: Plan timed lectures around learning objectives
skills.prompt: Plan a 90-minute introductory lecture on database normalization for second-year students, including a worked example, group activity, and exit question.

skills.title: Teaching Materials
skills.summary: Draft source-grounded slides, notes, and handouts
skills.prompt: Turn my supplied recursion notes into a concise slide outline, speaker notes, and a student handout; keep instructor answers separate.

skills.title: Assessment Design
skills.summary: Align questions and rubrics with course objectives
skills.prompt: Draft a formative assessment on SQL joins with an objective map, a 20-point rubric, and a separate instructor answer key.

skills.title: Feedback Assistant
skills.summary: Draft evidence-linked feedback for instructor review
skills.prompt: Using the supplied rubric and de-identified student response, draft constructive feedback with evidence and next steps; leave the final grade to me.

skills.title: Socratic Tutor
skills.summary: Explore understanding through questions and hints
skills.prompt: Help me understand recursion. Ask what I already know, then guide me through one small example and respond to my reasoning.

skills.title: Worked Example Coach
skills.summary: Explain reasoning, then fade support into practice
skills.prompt: Show a worked example of binary search, explain each decision, then give me a similar problem to solve with less help.

skills.title: Retrieval Practice
skills.summary: Practice recall with feedback and spaced review
skills.prompt: Quiz me on database normalization one question at a time, check my reasoning, and revisit concepts I miss.

skills.title: Study Planning
skills.summary: Build realistic study blocks around time and goals
skills.prompt: Help me plan two weeks of study for my algorithms exam using my deadlines, available hours, and topics I find difficult.

skills.title: Research Source Checking
skills.summary: Check whether sources support academic claims
skills.prompt: Check the references and claims in my supplied teaching notes; distinguish verified support, contradictions, and sources you cannot access.

skills.title: Responsible AI Use
skills.summary: Apply course AI policies and document assistance
skills.prompt: Help me interpret my course's AI policy and prepare an honest AI-use disclosure for the work I actually did.
